events.question: Is your character a boy?
events.note: Achilles is male; this opening question is interpreted as a gender question.

events.question: Is your character real?
events.note: Achilles is a mythological hero.

events.question: Does your character wear a hat?
events.note: No ordinary hat is a defining feature; a battle helmet is armor.

events.question: Does your character have a human nose?
events.note: Achilles has a human form.

events.question: Is your character from an anime?
events.note: The target originates in Greek mythology, without choosing an adaptation.

events.question: Does your character have special powers?
events.note: Many traditions give Achilles exceptional or supernatural abilities, including invulnerability apart from his heel.

events.question: Is your character from a game?
events.note: His origin is Greek mythology.

events.question: Does your character go to school?
events.note: Achilles is a warrior in the Trojan War, not a school pupil.

events.question: Is your character from a movie?
events.note: The target is the mythological hero, not a particular movie portrayal.

events.question: Is your character from a TV series?
events.note: The target originates in Greek mythology.

events.question: Is your character black-haired?
events.note: Homer describes Achilles as fair-haired.

events.question: Is your character blond?
events.note: Homer describes fair or golden hair.

events.question: Is your character in love with a man?
events.note: Achilles deeply loves Patroclus; a romantic interpretation occurs in ancient and later traditions, but is not uniform.

events.question: Is your character from a manhwa?
events.note: His origin is Greek mythology and epic.

events.question: Is your character from a book?
events.note: Achilles is a central character in the Iliad.

events.question: Does your character have Greek origins?
events.note: Achilles is a Greek mythological hero.

events.question: Has your character lived over a 100 years?
events.note: Interpreted as lifespan: Achilles dies young, rather than living for more than a century.

events.question: Is your character some kind of doctor?
events.note: His defining role is a warrior, not a physician.

events.question: Has your character been dead for more than 1000 years?
events.note: Within the mythological chronology, his death is in the ancient Trojan War era.

events.question: Has your character played with Brad Pitt?
events.note: Achilles is not an actor or costar; Brad Pitt portraying him does not mean he played with Pitt.

events.question: Is your character a war hero?
events.note: He is a hero of the Trojan War.

events.question: Does your character fight against monsters?
events.note: Achilles mainly fights human warriors in the Trojan War; monster slaying is not his defining role.

events.question: Has your character ever died in a movie?
events.note: A portrayal of Achilles dies in the film Troy; this asks about any depiction, not the character origin.

events.question: Is your character a demigod?
events.note: Achilles is the son of the goddess Thetis and mortal Peleus.

events.name: Achilles
events.note: Exact match to the mythological Trojan War hero.
